name: Alberta: catalogue of bills given Royal Assent (metadata only, no law text) and legal-system facts
label: Alberta
record_note: Metadata only, no law text: the official laws site could not be used. The catalogue lists the 1025 bills given Royal Assent from 2001-05-31 to 2026-05-14 (25th Legislature, 1st session to the 31st Legislature, 2nd session), each dated by its assent day, with title, bill number and chapter; checked against the Legislative Assembly records on 2026-10-30.

dates.commit: catalogue: the Royal Assent day; legal-system: the dated Wikidata fact, else the item's latest revision

reuse: No law text is reproduced. Bill numbers, titles, assent dates and chapters are facts recorded by the Legislative Assembly of Alberta; the legal-system facts are from Wikidata (CC0).
